netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lg n1 n2
C Cg n2 VSS
NMOS M1 n4 n2 n3 VSS
L Ls n3 n8
L Ld VDD n4
C Ct1 n4 n5
C Ct2 n5 VSS
C Cout n5 VOUT1
NMOS M2 n6 n4 n7 VSS
L Lc n7 VDD
PMOS P1 n6 VDD n4 VDD
rationale: The current topology suffers from poor noise performance (NF ≈ 17 dB vs target 1.8 dB), indicating insufficient input transconductance and/or high input-referred noise. The binding constraint is NF, with a massive negative normalized margin, while S11 and S21 are also below target. The primary issue is the lack of a proper input matching network and insufficient gain at the input stage. Adding a source degeneration inductor (Ls) in series with the NMOS source improves input impedance matching and boosts effective transconductance, thereby reducing noise figure and improving S11/S21 via better gain and matching. This is a minimal, targeted edit that directly addresses the NF bottleneck without disrupting the existing structure or violating the device budget.
